use function FddRuntime\{units, fromUnits, compareUnits, unitIndex, bool_, num_, get, item, obj, eq, mod, orElse, iter, indexed, range, counting, map, filter, find, some, every, mapAsync, filterAsync, findAsync, someAsync, everyAsync, key_, index_, trunc_, numText, jsString, json, quote_, jsTrim, jsNumber, prim_, lt_, truthy, isEmpty, isNull, deepEqual, compare, toNum, divide, asArray, isFound, omitNulls, segments, segKey, unsafe_, hasPath, getPath, lookup_, container_, shallow_, setPath, setIn_, deepClone_, removePath, removeIn_, spread_, merge, transform, template, fill_, parseJson, toError, str, asString, contains, startsWith, endsWith, trim, lower, upper, strLength, concat, splitUnits_, replaceAll, split, join, rx_, regexMatch, format, len, at, append, includes, sum, sortBy, first, last, groupBy, average, valid_, invalid_, checkRequired, checkEmail, valueType_, checkType, checkValue_, checkShape, checkRange, checkRegex, checkPassword, toStringValue, toNumber, isNumeric, toBoolean, typeOf, jsMin_, jsMax_, round, floor, ceil, abs, min, max, clamp, power, sqrt, relIndex_, substring, indexOf, pad_, padStart, padEnd, base64Encode, base64Decode, formatNumber, digestAlgorithm_, encodeDigest_, hash, hmac, urlEncode, urlDecode, isIndexKey_, keyList, keys, values, entries, slice, reverse, unique, itemIndex, flatten, fdivInt_, daysFromCivil_, civilFromDays_, daysIn_, dateMs_, needDate_, dateFields_, isoDate_, timeUnit_, parseDate, formatDate, addTime, timeBetween, dateParts, makeDate, periodEdge_, startOf, endOf, now, uuid, random, log, sleep};
use FddRuntime\FddError;

function signIn(mixed $request, mixed $deps): mixed
{
    $__f = \FddVerify::frame("bp-auth-login");
    $__f->enter("NODE-AUTH-LOGIN-001");
    $email = get(get($request, "body"), "email");
    $emailCheck = checkEmail($email, "email");
    $password = get(get($request, "body"), "password");
    $__f->enter("NODE-AUTH-LOGIN-006");
    if (!(bool_(get($emailCheck, "valid")) && !isEmpty($password))) {
        $__f->enter("NODE-AUTH-LOGIN-009");
        return obj(
            "status", 401.0,
            "body", obj(
                "error", bool_(get($emailCheck, "valid")) ? get(checkRequired($password, "password"), "message") : get($emailCheck, "message"),
            ),
        );
    }
    $__f->enter("NODE-AUTH-LOGIN-010");
    $lookUpUser = \FddVerify::dep("userService", "getUsersByEmail", "NODE-AUTH-LOGIN-010", [obj("query", omitNulls(obj("email", $email)))]);
    $status1 = get($lookUpUser, "status");
    if (eq($status1, 200.0)) {
        $__f->enter("NODE-AUTH-LOGIN-014");
        if (!eq(get(get($lookUpUser, "body"), "passwordHash"), format("hash:{password}", obj("password", $password)))) {
            $__f->enter("NODE-AUTH-LOGIN-021");
            return obj("status", 401.0, "body", obj("error", "Invalid credentials"));
        }
        $id = get(get($lookUpUser, "body"), "id");
        $__f->enter("NODE-AUTH-LOGIN-018");
        \FddVerify::dep("eventBus", "publishUserLoggedIn", "NODE-AUTH-LOGIN-018", [obj("userId", $id)]);
        $__f->enter("NODE-AUTH-LOGIN-019");
        return obj(
            "status", 200.0,
            "body", obj(
                "accessToken", format("TEST-TOKEN-{id}", obj("id", $id)),
                "refreshToken", "REFRESH-TOKEN",
                "expiresIn", 3600.0,
                "tokenType", "Bearer",
            ),
        );
    } elseif (eq($status1, 404.0)) {
        $__f->enter("NODE-AUTH-LOGIN-022");
        return obj("status", 401.0, "body", obj("error", "Invalid credentials"));
    } else {
        $__f->enter("NODE-AUTH-LOGIN-023");
        throw new FddError("UPSTREAM_ERROR", "User Service failed");
    }
}

<?php
// Runtime for code generated by Rabbinatix from Logic Blueprints. Do not edit: it is regenerated on export.
// Every helper mirrors the simulator, so generated handlers behave exactly like their blueprints.
// Values are JSON values: \stdClass objects (keys in order), lists (PHP arrays), strings, floats, bools and null.
// Text is UTF-8; lengths and positions count UTF-16 units, as JavaScript does. PHP 8.1+ with mbstring.

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace FddRuntime;

/** An error with a code, like the simulator's errors (Throw nodes, DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, INVALID_JSON...). */
class FddError extends \RuntimeException
{
    public readonly string $errorCode;

    public function __construct(mixed $code, mixed $message)
    {
        parent::__construct(asString($message));
        $this->errorCode = asString($code);
    }
}

/** An error that stops a handler: Try and Retry never catch it. */
interface FddStop
{
}

/** Converts between your own values and the JSON values the handlers take and return. */
final class FddJson
{
    /** Arrays (lists and maps), numbers of any type, JsonSerializable and plain objects as JSON values. */
    public static function toValue(mixed $v): mixed
    {
        if ($v === null || \is_string($v) || \is_bool($v)) return $v;
        if (\is_int($v) || \is_float($v)) return (float) $v;
        if ($v instanceof \BackedEnum) return self::toValue($v->value);
        if ($v instanceof \JsonSerializable) return self::toValue($v->jsonSerialize());
        if (\is_array($v)) {
            if (\array_is_list($v)) return \array_map(self::toValue(...), $v);
            $o = new \stdClass();
            foreach ($v as $k => $x) $o->{(string) $k} = self::toValue($x);
            return $o;
        }
        if (\is_object($v)) {
            $o = new \stdClass();
            foreach (\get_object_vars($v) as $k => $x) if ($x !== null || $v instanceof \stdClass) $o->{(string) $k} = self::toValue($x);
            return $o;
        }
        return (string) $v;
    }

    /** JSON text as JSON values; fails with FddError INVALID_JSON. */
    public static function parse(string $text): mixed
    {
        return (new JsonReader($text))->document();
    }

    /** JSON values as JSON text (JSON.stringify). */
    public static function stringify(mixed $v): string
    {
        return json($v);
    }
}

/** Strict JSON (what JSON.parse accepts); numbers become floats, objects \stdClass. */
final class JsonReader
{
    private int $i = 0;

    public function __construct(private readonly string $s)
    {
    }

    private function bad(): FddError
    {
        return new FddError('INVALID_JSON', 'Not valid JSON');
    }

    public function document(): mixed
    {
        $this->ws();
        $v = $this->value();
        $this->ws();
        if ($this->i !== \strlen($this->s)) throw $this->bad();
        return $v;
    }

    private function ws(): void
    {
        while ($this->i < \strlen($this->s) && \strpos(" \t\n\r", $this->s[$this->i]) !== false) $this->i++;
    }

    private function peek(): string
    {
        if ($this->i >= \strlen($this->s)) throw $this->bad();
        return $this->s[$this->i];
    }

    private function value(): mixed
    {
        $c = $this->peek();
        if ($c === '{') return $this->object();
        if ($c === '[') return $this->array();
        if ($c === '"') return $this->string();
        foreach (['true' => true, 'false' => false, 'null' => null] as $w => $v) {
            if (\substr_compare($this->s, $w, $this->i, \strlen($w)) === 0) {
                $this->i += \strlen($w);
                return $v;
            }
        }
        if (!\preg_match('/-?(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)(?:\.[0-9]+)?(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?/A', $this->s, $m, 0, $this->i)) throw $this->bad();
        $this->i += \strlen($m[0]);
        return (float) $m[0];
    }

    private function object(): \stdClass
    {
        $o = new \stdClass();
        $this->i++;
        $this->ws();
        if ($this->peek() === '}') {
            $this->i++;
            return $o;
        }
        while (true) {
            $this->ws();
            if ($this->peek() !== '"') throw $this->bad();
            $k = $this->string();
            $this->ws();
            if ($this->peek() !== ':') throw $this->bad();
            $this->i++;
            $this->ws();
            $o->{$k} = $this->value();
            $this->ws();
            $c = $this->peek();
            $this->i++;
            if ($c === '}') return $o;
            if ($c !== ',') throw $this->bad();
        }
    }

    private function array(): array
    {
        $l = [];
        $this->i++;
        $this->ws();
        if ($this->peek() === ']') {
            $this->i++;
            return $l;
        }
        while (true) {
            $this->ws();
            $l[] = $this->value();
            $this->ws();
            $c = $this->peek();
            $this->i++;
            if ($c === ']') return $l;
            if ($c !== ',') throw $this->bad();
        }
    }

    private function string(): string
    {
        $this->i++;
        $units = [];
        $out = '';
        while (true) {
            $c = $this->peek();
            $this->i++;
            if ($c === '"') return $out . fromUnits($units);
            if (\ord($c) < 0x20) throw $this->bad();
            if ($c !== '\\') {
                if ($units) {
                    $out .= fromUnits($units);
                    $units = [];
                }
                $out .= $c;
                continue;
            }
            $e = $this->peek();
            $this->i++;
            $simple = ['"' => '"', '\\' => '\\', '/' => '/', 'b' => "\x08", 'f' => "\x0c", 'n' => "\n", 'r' => "\r", 't' => "\t"];
            if (isset($simple[$e])) {
                if ($units) {
                    $out .= fromUnits($units);
                    $units = [];
                }
                $out .= $simple[$e];
                continue;
            }
            if ($e !== 'u' || !\preg_match('/[0-9a-fA-F]{4}/A', $this->s, $m, 0, $this->i)) throw $this->bad();
            $this->i += 4;
            // \u escapes are UTF-16 units: a pair becomes one character
            $units[] = \hexdec($m[0]);
        }
    }
}

// ---------- text as UTF-16 units ----------

/** The UTF-16 units of UTF-8 text (a lone surrogate written as its own 3 bytes stays one unit). */
function units(string $s): array
{
    $out = [];
    $n = \strlen($s);
    for ($i = 0; $i < $n;) {
        $b = \ord($s[$i]);
        if ($b < 0x80) {
            $cp = $b;
            $i++;
        } elseif ($b < 0xe0 && $i + 1 < $n) {
            $cp = (($b & 0x1f) << 6) | (\ord($s[$i + 1]) & 0x3f);
            $i += 2;
        } elseif ($b < 0xf0 && $i + 2 < $n) {
            $cp = (($b & 0x0f) << 12) | ((\ord($s[$i + 1]) & 0x3f) << 6) | (\ord($s[$i + 2]) & 0x3f);
            $i += 3;
        } elseif ($i + 3 < $n) {
            $cp = (($b & 0x07) << 18) | ((\ord($s[$i + 1]) & 0x3f) << 12) | ((\ord($s[$i + 2]) & 0x3f) << 6) | (\ord($s[$i + 3]) & 0x3f);
            $i += 4;
        } else {
            $cp = 0xfffd;
            $i++;
        }
        if ($cp >= 0x10000) {
            $cp -= 0x10000;
            $out[] = 0xd800 | ($cp >> 10);
            $out[] = 0xdc00 | ($cp & 0x3ff);
        } else {
            $out[] = $cp;
        }
    }
    return $out;
}

/** UTF-16 units as UTF-8 text (pairs joined; a lone surrogate as its own 3 bytes). */
function fromUnits(array $u): string
{
    $out = '';
    $n = \count($u);
    for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
        $c = $u[$i];
        if ($c >= 0xd800 && $c <= 0xdbff && $i + 1 < $n && $u[$i + 1] >= 0xdc00 && $u[$i + 1] <= 0xdfff) {
            $c = 0x10000 + (($c - 0xd800) << 10) + ($u[$i + 1] - 0xdc00);
            $i++;
        }
        if ($c < 0x80) $out .= \chr($c);
        elseif ($c < 0x800) $out .= \chr(0xc0 | ($c >> 6)) . \chr(0x80 | ($c & 0x3f));
        elseif ($c < 0x10000) $out .= \chr(0xe0 | ($c >> 12)) . \chr(0x80 | (($c >> 6) & 0x3f)) . \chr(0x80 | ($c & 0x3f));
        else $out .= \chr(0xf0 | ($c >> 18)) . \chr(0x80 | (($c >> 12) & 0x3f)) . \chr(0x80 | (($c >> 6) & 0x3f)) . \chr(0x80 | ($c & 0x3f));
    }
    return $out;
}

/** compares texts unit by unit, like JavaScript's < on strings */
function compareUnits(string $a, string $b): int
{
    $x = units($a);
    $y = units($b);
    $n = \min(\count($x), \count($y));
    for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) if ($x[$i] !== $y[$i]) return $x[$i] < $y[$i] ? -1 : 1;
    return \count($x) <=> \count($y);
}

/** the position of a text in another, in UTF-16 units, or -1 */
function unitIndex(array $t, array $s, int $from = 0): int
{
    $n = \count($t);
    $m = \count($s);
    for ($i = $from; $i + $m <= $n; $i++) {
        if (\array_slice($t, $i, $m) === $s) return $i;
    }
    return -1;
}

// ---------- the value model the generated code uses ----------

/** A condition: true only for true, else JavaScript truthiness. */
function bool_(mixed $v): bool
{
    return \is_bool($v) ? $v : truthy($v);
}

/** A number operand. */
function num_(mixed $v): float
{
    return toNum($v);
}

/** o.name, null-safe: null when o is null or has no such field. */
function get(mixed $o, string $name): mixed
{
    return key_($o, $name);
}

/** o[key], null-safe. */
function item(mixed $o, mixed $k): mixed
{
    return key_($o, $k);
}

/** An object from key, value, key, value... */
function obj(mixed ...$kv): \stdClass
{
    $o = new \stdClass();
    for ($i = 0; $i + 1 < \count($kv); $i += 2) $o->{$kv[$i]} = $kv[$i + 1];
    return $o;
}

/** a === b for strings, numbers, booleans and null (objects: the same one). */
function eq(mixed $a, mixed $b): bool
{
    if ((\is_int($a) || \is_float($a)) && (\is_int($b) || \is_float($b))) return (float) $a === (float) $b;
    return $a === $b;
}

/** a % b (JavaScript's remainder). */
function mod(float $a, float $b): float
{
    return \fmod($a, $b);
}

/** a ?? b with b evaluated first (b has no effects). */
function orElse(mixed $a, mixed $b): mixed
{
    return $a ?? $b;
}

function iter(mixed $v): array
{
    return \is_array($v) ? $v : [];
}

/** [index, item] of a list; the index is a number. */
function indexed(mixed $v): \Generator
{
    foreach (iter($v) as $i => $x) yield [(float) $i, $x];
}

/** from, from + 1, ... while at most to. */
function range(float $from, float $to): \Generator
{
    for ($i = $from; $i <= $to; $i++) yield $i;
}

/** from, from + 1, ... without end (the loop stops itself). */
function counting(float $from): \Generator
{
    for ($i = $from;; $i++) yield $i;
}

function map(mixed $items, callable $fn): array
{
    $out = [];
    foreach (asArray($items) as $i => $x) $out[] = $fn($x, (float) $i);
    return $out;
}

function filter(mixed $items, callable $fn): array
{
    $out = [];
    foreach (asArray($items) as $i => $x) if ($fn($x, (float) $i)) $out[] = $x;
    return $out;
}

function find(mixed $items, callable $fn): mixed
{
    foreach (asArray($items) as $i => $x) if ($fn($x, (float) $i)) return $x;
    return null;
}

function some(mixed $items, callable $fn): bool
{
    foreach (asArray($items) as $i => $x) if ($fn($x, (float) $i)) return true;
    return false;
}

function every(mixed $items, callable $fn): bool
{
    foreach (asArray($items) as $i => $x) if (!$fn($x, (float) $i)) return false;
    return true;
}

/** One item at a time (deterministic order). */
function mapAsync(mixed $items, callable $fn): array
{
    return map($items, $fn);
}

function filterAsync(mixed $items, callable $fn): array
{
    return filter($items, fn($x, $i) => truthy($fn($x, $i)));
}

function findAsync(mixed $items, callable $fn): mixed
{
    return find($items, fn($x, $i) => truthy($fn($x, $i)));
}

function someAsync(mixed $items, callable $fn): bool
{
    return some($items, fn($x, $i) => truthy($fn($x, $i)));
}

function everyAsync(mixed $items, callable $fn): bool
{
    return every($items, fn($x, $i) => truthy($fn($x, $i)));
}

function key_(mixed $o, mixed $k): mixed
{
    if ($o instanceof \stdClass) {
        $key = \is_string($k) ? $k : jsString($k);
        return \property_exists($o, $key) ? $o->{$key} : null;
    }
    if (\is_array($o)) {
        if ($k === 'length') return (float) \count($o);
        $i = index_($k);
        return $i >= 0 && $i < \count($o) ? $o[$i] : null;
    }
    if (\is_string($o)) {
        $u = units($o);
        if ($k === 'length') return (float) \count($u);
        $i = index_($k);
        return $i >= 0 && $i < \count($u) ? fromUnits([$u[$i]]) : null;
    }
    return null;
}

/** A list position, or -1. */
function index_(mixed $k): int
{
    if (\is_int($k) || \is_float($k)) $d = (float) $k;
    elseif (\is_string($k) && \preg_match('/^[0-9]+$/', $k)) $d = (float) $k;
    else return -1;
    return $d >= 0 && $d < 2147483647 && \floor($d) === $d ? (int) $d : -1;
}

function trunc_(float $d): float
{
    return \is_finite($d) ? ($d < 0 ? \ceil($d) : \floor($d)) : $d;
}

// ---------- JavaScript conversions ----------

/** A number as JavaScript's String(n) writes it. */
function numText(float $n): string
{
    if (\is_nan($n)) return 'NaN';
    if (\is_infinite($n)) return $n > 0 ? 'Infinity' : '-Infinity';
    if ($n == 0) return '0';
    // the shortest digits that read back as the same number
    $a = \abs($n);
    for ($p = 1; $p <= 17; $p++) {
        $t = \sprintf('%.' . ($p - 1) . 'e', $a);
        if ((float) $t === $a) break;
    }
    [$mant, $exp] = \explode('e', $t);
    $digits = \rtrim(\str_replace('.', '', $mant), '0');
    if ($digits === '') $digits = '0';
    $k = \strlen($digits);
    $point = (int) $exp + 1;
    $sign = $n < 0 ? '-' : '';
    if ($k <= $point && $point <= 21) return $sign . $digits . \str_repeat('0', $point - $k);
    if (0 < $point && $point <= 21) return $sign . \substr($digits, 0, $point) . '.' . \substr($digits, $point);
    if (-6 < $point && $point <= 0) return $sign . '0.' . \str_repeat('0', -$point) . $digits;
    $x = $point - 1;
    return $sign . $digits[0] . ($k > 1 ? '.' . \substr($digits, 1) : '') . 'e' . ($x >= 0 ? '+' : '-') . \abs($x);
}

/** String(v). */
function jsString(mixed $v): string
{
    if ($v === null) return 'null';
    if (\is_bool($v)) return $v ? 'true' : 'false';
    if (\is_int($v) || \is_float($v)) return numText((float) $v);
    if (\is_string($v)) return $v;
    if (\is_array($v)) return \implode(',', \array_map(fn($x) => $x === null ? '' : jsString($x), $v));
    if ($v instanceof \stdClass) return '[object Object]';
    if ($v instanceof \Throwable) return $v->getMessage();
    return \is_object($v) && \method_exists($v, '__toString') ? (string) $v : \get_debug_type($v);
}

/** JSON.stringify. */
function json(mixed $v): string
{
    if ($v === null) return 'null';
    if (\is_bool($v)) return $v ? 'true' : 'false';
    if (\is_int($v) || \is_float($v)) return \is_finite((float) $v) ? numText((float) $v) : 'null';
    if (\is_string($v)) return quote_($v);
    if (\is_array($v)) return '[' . \implode(',', \array_map(json(...), $v)) . ']';
    if ($v instanceof \stdClass) {
        $parts = [];
        foreach (keyList($v) as $k) $parts[] = quote_($k) . ':' . json($v->{$k});
        return '{' . \implode(',', $parts) . '}';
    }
    return quote_(jsString($v));
}

function quote_(string $s): string
{
    $out = '"';
    $u = units($s);
    $n = \count($u);
    for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
        $c = $u[$i];
        $esc = ['"' => '\\"', '\\' => '\\\\', "\n" => '\\n', "\r" => '\\r', "\t" => '\\t', "\x08" => '\\b', "\x0c" => '\\f'];
        if ($c < 0x80 && isset($esc[\chr($c)])) $out .= $esc[\chr($c)];
        elseif ($c < 0x20) $out .= \sprintf('\\u%04x', $c);
        elseif ($c >= 0xd800 && $c <= 0xdbff && $i + 1 < $n && $u[$i + 1] >= 0xdc00 && $u[$i + 1] <= 0xdfff) {
            $out .= fromUnits([$c, $u[$i + 1]]);
            $i++;
        } elseif ($c >= 0xd800 && $c <= 0xdfff) $out .= \sprintf('\\u%04x', $c);
        else $out .= fromUnits([$c]);
    }
    return $out . '"';
}

/** JavaScript's white space and line terminators (what String.prototype.trim removes). */
const JS_SPACE = "[\\x{9}-\\x{d}\\x{20}\\x{a0}\\x{1680}\\x{2000}-\\x{200a}\\x{2028}\\x{2029}\\x{202f}\\x{205f}\\x{3000}\\x{feff}]";

function jsTrim(string $s): string
{
    $t = \preg_replace('/^' . JS_SPACE . '+|' . JS_SPACE . '+$/u', '', $s);
    return $t ?? \trim($s);
}

/** Number(v). */
function jsNumber(mixed $v): float
{
    if ($v === null) return 0.0;
    if (\is_bool($v)) return $v ? 1.0 : 0.0;
    if (\is_int($v) || \is_float($v)) return (float) $v;
    if (\is_string($v)) {
        $t = jsTrim($v);
        if ($t === '') return 0.0;
        if (\preg_match('/^0([xXoObB])([0-9a-fA-F]+)$/', $t, $m)) {
            $radix = \stripos('x', $m[1]) !== false ? 16 : (\stripos('o', $m[1]) !== false ? 8 : 2);
            $acc = 0.0;
            foreach (\str_split(\strtolower($m[2])) as $c) {
                $d = \hexdec($c);
                if ($d >= $radix) return \NAN;
                $acc = $acc * $radix + $d;
            }
            return $acc;
        }
        if ($t === 'Infinity' || $t === '+Infinity') return \INF;
        if ($t === '-Infinity') return -\INF;
        return \preg_match('/^[+-]?(\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)([eE][+-]?\d+)?$/', $t) ? (float) $t : \NAN;
    }
    if (\is_array($v)) {
        if (!$v) return 0.0;
        if (\count($v) === 1) {
            $x = $v[0];
            return \is_array($x) || \is_object($x) ? \NAN : ($x === null ? 0.0 : jsNumber($x));
        }
    }
    return \NAN;
}

function prim_(mixed $x): mixed
{
    return \is_array($x) || \is_object($x) ? jsString($x) : $x;
}

function lt_(mixed $a, mixed $b): bool
{
    if (\is_string($a) && \is_string($b)) return compareUnits($a, $b) < 0;
    return jsNumber(prim_($a)) < jsNumber(prim_($b));
}

// ---------- values ----------

/** Branch semantics: "" and "false" are false. */
function truthy(mixed $v): bool
{
    if ($v === null) return false;
    if (\is_string($v)) return $v !== '' && $v !== 'false';
    if (\is_bool($v)) return $v;
    if (\is_int($v) || \is_float($v)) return $v != 0 && !\is_nan((float) $v);
    return true;
}

/** null, "", [] or {}. */
function isEmpty(mixed $v): bool
{
    if ($v === null) return true;
    if (\is_string($v)) return jsTrim($v) === '';
    if (\is_array($v)) return !$v;
    if ($v instanceof \stdClass) return !\get_object_vars($v);
    return false;
}

/** null or missing. */
function isNull(mixed $v): bool
{
    return $v === null;
}

/** Structural equality (objects and arrays by value). */
function deepEqual(mixed $a, mixed $b): bool
{
    if ((\is_int($a) || \is_float($a)) && (\is_int($b) || \is_float($b))) return (float) $a === (float) $b || (\is_nan((float) $a) && \is_nan((float) $b));
    if (\is_array($a) && \is_array($b)) {
        if (\count($a) !== \count($b)) return false;
        foreach ($a as $i => $x) if (!deepEqual($x, $b[$i])) return false;
        return true;
    }
    if ($a instanceof \stdClass && $b instanceof \stdClass) {
        $x = \get_object_vars($a);
        $y = \get_object_vars($b);
        if (\count($x) !== \count($y)) return false;
        foreach (keyList($a) as $k) if (!\property_exists($b, $k) || !deepEqual($a->{$k}, $b->{$k})) return false;
        return true;
    }
    return eq($a, $b);
}

/** -1, 0 or 1. */
function compare(mixed $a, mixed $b): float
{
    return deepEqual($a, $b) ? 0.0 : (lt_($a, $b) ? -1.0 : 1.0);
}

/** An arithmetic operand: numbers as is, anything else through Number(). */
function toNum(mixed $v): float
{
    return \is_float($v) ? $v : (\is_int($v) ? (float) $v : jsNumber($v));
}

/** Fails on zero. */
function divide(mixed $a, mixed $b): float
{
    if (toNum($b) == 0) throw new FddError('DIVIDE_BY_ZERO', 'Division by zero');
    return \fdiv(toNum($a), toNum($b));
}

/** The value if it is a list, else []. */
function asArray(mixed $v): array
{
    return \is_array($v) ? $v : [];
}

/** A query found something (not null, not an empty list). */
function isFound(mixed $v): bool
{
    return \is_array($v) ? (bool) $v : $v !== null;
}

/** Drops null entries (query and header maps). */
function omitNulls(mixed $o): \stdClass
{
    $out = new \stdClass();
    if ($o instanceof \stdClass) foreach (keyList($o) as $k) if ($o->{$k} !== null) $out->{$k} = $o->{$k};
    return $out;
}

// ---------- paths & objects ----------

/** A path that isn't there (JavaScript's undefined): left out of objects, like JSON.stringify does. */
final class Missing
{
    public static function it(): self
    {
        static $m = null;
        return $m ??= new self();
    }
}

/** user.roles[0].name → [['name', 'user'], ['name', 'roles'], ['index', 0], ['name', 'name']] */
function segments(string $path): array
{
    $out = [];
    foreach (\explode('.', $path) as $part) {
        if ($part === '') continue;
        \preg_match_all('/([^\[\]]+)|\[(\d+)\]/', $part, $ms, \PREG_SET_ORDER);
        foreach ($ms as $m) $out[] = isset($m[2]) && $m[2] !== '' ? [null, \strlen($m[2]) > 9 ? 2147483647 : (int) $m[2]] : [$m[1], -1];
    }
    return $out;
}

function segKey(array $s): string
{
    return $s[0] ?? (string) $s[1];
}

function unsafe_(array $segs): bool
{
    foreach ($segs as $s) if (\in_array($s[0], ['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype'], true)) return true;
    return false;
}

/** The path exists (its value may be null). */
function hasPath(mixed $value, mixed $path): bool
{
    $p = str($path);
    if ($p === '' || $p === '$') return true;
    $segs = segments($p);
    if (unsafe_($segs)) return false;
    $cur = $value;
    foreach ($segs as $s) {
        if ($cur instanceof \stdClass) {
            if (!\property_exists($cur, segKey($s))) return false;
            $cur = $cur->{segKey($s)};
        } elseif (\is_array($cur) || \is_string($cur)) {
            $n = \is_array($cur) ? \count($cur) : \count(units($cur));
            if ($s[0] === 'length') $cur = (float) $n;
            elseif ($s[0] === null && $s[1] < $n) $cur = key_($cur, $s[1]);
            else return false;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

/** Reads a nested value; null when a step is missing. */
function getPath(mixed $value, mixed $path): mixed
{
    $p = str($path);
    if ($p === '' || $p === '$') return $value;
    $segs = segments($p);
    if (unsafe_($segs)) return null;
    $cur = $value;
    foreach ($segs as $s) {
        if ($cur === null) return null;
        $cur = key_($cur, $s[0] ?? (float) $s[1]);
    }
    return $cur;
}

function lookup_(mixed $value, string $path): mixed
{
    return hasPath($value, $path) ? getPath($value, $path) : Missing::it();
}

function container_(mixed $v): bool
{
    return \is_array($v) || $v instanceof \stdClass;
}

function shallow_(mixed $v): mixed
{
    return $v instanceof \stdClass ? clone $v : $v;
}

/** A copy with a nested value set. */
function setPath(mixed $value, mixed $path, mixed $v): mixed
{
    $segs = segments(str($path));
    if (!$segs) return $v;
    $root = container_($value) ? shallow_($value) : new \stdClass();
    if (unsafe_($segs)) return $root;
    return setIn_($root, $segs, 0, $v);
}

/** Sets segs[i..] in cur (a fresh copy) and returns it. */
function setIn_(mixed $cur, array $segs, int $i, mixed $v): mixed
{
    $s = $segs[$i];
    $last = $i === \count($segs) - 1;
    if (\is_array($cur)) {
        if ($s[0] !== null) return $cur;
        while (\count($cur) <= $s[1]) $cur[] = null;
        if ($last) {
            if (!$v instanceof Missing) $cur[$s[1]] = $v;
            return $cur;
        }
        $next = shallow_($cur[$s[1]]);
        if (!container_($next)) $next = $segs[$i + 1][0] === null ? [] : new \stdClass();
        $cur[$s[1]] = setIn_($next, $segs, $i + 1, $v);
        return $cur;
    }
    $k = segKey($s);
    if ($last) {
        if (!$v instanceof Missing) $cur->{$k} = $v;
        return $cur;
    }
    $next = \property_exists($cur, $k) ? shallow_($cur->{$k}) : null;
    if (!container_($next)) $next = $segs[$i + 1][0] === null ? [] : new \stdClass();
    $cur->{$k} = setIn_($next, $segs, $i + 1, $v);
    return $cur;
}

function deepClone_(mixed $v): mixed
{
    if (\is_array($v)) return \array_map(deepClone_(...), $v);
    if ($v instanceof \stdClass) {
        $o = new \stdClass();
        foreach ($v as $k => $x) $o->{(string) $k} = deepClone_($x);
        return $o;
    }
    return $v;
}

/** A copy without a nested value. */
function removePath(mixed $value, mixed $path): mixed
{
    $segs = segments(str($path));
    if (!$segs || !container_($value)) return $value;
    $clone = deepClone_($value);
    if (unsafe_($segs)) return $clone;
    return removeIn_($clone, $segs, 0);
}

function removeIn_(mixed $cur, array $segs, int $i): mixed
{
    $s = $segs[$i];
    if ($i === \count($segs) - 1) {
        if (\is_array($cur) && $s[0] === null && $s[1] < \count($cur)) \array_splice($cur, $s[1], 1);
        elseif ($cur instanceof \stdClass) unset($cur->{segKey($s)});
        return $cur;
    }
    if ($cur instanceof \stdClass) {
        $k = segKey($s);
        if (\property_exists($cur, $k) && container_($cur->{$k})) $cur->{$k} = removeIn_($cur->{$k}, $segs, $i + 1);
    } elseif (\is_array($cur) && $s[0] === null && $s[1] < \count($cur) && container_($cur[$s[1]])) {
        $cur[$s[1]] = removeIn_($cur[$s[1]], $segs, $i + 1);
    }
    return $cur;
}

function spread_(mixed $v, \stdClass $into): void
{
    if ($v instanceof \stdClass) foreach (keyList($v) as $k) $into->{$k} = $v->{$k};
    elseif (\is_array($v)) foreach ($v as $i => $x) $into->{(string) $i} = $x;
    elseif (\is_string($v)) foreach (units($v) as $i => $c) $into->{(string) $i} = fromUnits([$c]);
}

/** Shallow merge, B over A. */
function merge(mixed $a, mixed $b): \stdClass
{
    $o = new \stdClass();
    spread_($a, $o);
    spread_($b, $o);
    return $o;
}

/** A new object: target path from source path. */
function transform(mixed $source, mixed $mapping): mixed
{
    $out = new \stdClass();
    foreach (asArray($mapping) as $pair) {
        $p = asArray($pair);
        $out = setPath($out, $p[0] ?? null, lookup_($source, str($p[1] ?? null)));
    }
    return $out;
}

/** Fills {{path}} placeholders from data. */
function template(mixed $value, mixed $data): mixed
{
    $r = fill_($value, $data);
    return $r instanceof Missing ? null : $r;
}

function fill_(mixed $value, mixed $data): mixed
{
    if (\is_string($value)) {
        if (\preg_match('/^\{\{\s*([^}]+?)\s*\}\}$/', $value, $m)) return lookup_($data, $m[1]);
        return \preg_replace_callback('/\{\{\s*([^}]+?)\s*\}\}/', function ($m) use ($data) {
            $r = getPath($data, $m[1]);
            return $r === null ? '' : (container_($r) ? json($r) : jsString($r));
        }, $value);
    }
    if (\is_array($value)) return \array_map(function ($x) use ($data) {
        $z = fill_($x, $data);
        return $z instanceof Missing ? null : $z;
    }, $value);
    if ($value instanceof \stdClass) {
        $o = new \stdClass();
        foreach (keyList($value) as $k) {
            $z = fill_($value->{$k}, $data);
            if (!$z instanceof Missing) $o->{$k} = $z;
        }
        return $o;
    }
    return $value;
}

/** JSON.parse that fails with INVALID_JSON. */
function parseJson(mixed $text): mixed
{
    return FddJson::parse(jsString($text));
}

/** The { code, message } a Catch or Failed pin receives; an FddStop is thrown on. */
function toError(\Throwable $e): \stdClass
{
    if ($e instanceof FddStop) throw $e;
    if ($e instanceof FddError) return obj('code', $e->errorCode, 'message', $e->getMessage());
    return obj('code', 'RUNTIME_ERROR', 'message', $e->getMessage());
}

// ---------- strings ----------

/** A string operand: null is "". */
function str(mixed $v): string
{
    return $v === null ? '' : jsString($v);
}

/** String(v), like a Switch compares. */
function asString(mixed $v): string
{
    return jsString($v);
}

function contains(mixed $text, mixed $search): bool
{
    return \str_contains(str($text), str($search));
}

function startsWith(mixed $text, mixed $prefix): bool
{
    return \str_starts_with(str($text), str($prefix));
}

function endsWith(mixed $text, mixed $suffix): bool
{
    return \str_ends_with(str($text), str($suffix));
}

function trim(mixed $text): string
{
    return jsTrim(str($text));
}

function lower(mixed $text): string
{
    return \mb_strtolower(str($text), 'UTF-8');
}

function upper(mixed $text): string
{
    return \mb_strtoupper(str($text), 'UTF-8');
}

function strLength(mixed $text): float
{
    return (float) \count(units(str($text)));
}

function concat(mixed $a, mixed $b): string
{
    return str($a) . str($b);
}

/** text split on a separator (an empty one splits every UTF-16 unit, like JavaScript) */
function splitUnits_(string $t, string $s): array
{
    return $s === '' ? \array_map(fn($c) => fromUnits([$c]), units($t)) : \explode($s, $t);
}

function replaceAll(mixed $text, mixed $search, mixed $replacement): string
{
    return \implode(str($replacement), splitUnits_(str($text), str($search)));
}

/** An empty separator splits on ",". */
function split(mixed $text, mixed $separator): array
{
    $s = str($separator);
    return splitUnits_(str($text), $s === '' ? ',' : $s);
}

function join(mixed $items, mixed $separator): string
{
    return \implode(str($separator), \array_map(str(...), asArray($items)));
}

function rx_(string $pattern, string $flags): string
{
    if (\preg_match('/[^gimsuyd]/', $flags)) throw new FddError('INVALID_REGEX', "Invalid pattern $pattern");
    $re = '/' . \str_replace('/', '\/', $pattern) . '/u' . (\str_contains($flags, 'i') ? 'i' : '') . (\str_contains($flags, 'm') ? 'm' : '') . (\str_contains($flags, 's') ? 's' : '');
    if (@\preg_match($re, '') === false) throw new FddError('INVALID_REGEX', "Invalid pattern $pattern");
    return $re;
}

function regexMatch(mixed $text, mixed $pattern, mixed $flags): \stdClass
{
    $ok = \preg_match(rx_(str($pattern), str($flags)), str($text), $m, \PREG_UNMATCHED_AS_NULL);
    $groups = [];
    if ($ok) {
        for ($i = 1; $i < \count($m); $i++) $groups[] = $m[$i];
    }
    return obj('matches', $ok === 1, 'groups', $groups);
}

/** Fills {name} placeholders. */
function format(mixed $template, mixed $values): string
{
    return \preg_replace_callback('/\{(\w+)\}/', fn($m) => str(get($values, $m[1])), str($template));
}

// ---------- collections ----------

function len(mixed $a): float
{
    return \is_array($a) ? (float) \count($a) : 0.0;
}

function at(mixed $a, mixed $i): mixed
{
    return key_(asArray($a), toNum($i));
}

/** A copy with the item appended. */
function append(mixed $a, mixed $item): array
{
    $l = asArray($a);
    $l[] = $item;
    return $l;
}

/** Deep-equal membership. */
function includes(mixed $a, mixed $item): bool
{
    foreach (asArray($a) as $x) if (deepEqual($x, $item)) return true;
    return false;
}

function sum(mixed $a, mixed $path): float
{
    $p = str($path);
    $t = 0.0;
    foreach (asArray($a) as $x) $t += toNum($p !== '' ? getPath($x, $p) : $x);
    return $t;
}

function sortBy(mixed $a, mixed $path, mixed $desc): array
{
    $dir = truthy($desc) ? -1 : 1;
    $p = str($path);
    $l = asArray($a);
    // usort is stable since PHP 8.0, like Array.prototype.sort
    \usort($l, function ($x, $y) use ($p, $dir) {
        $u = $p !== '' ? getPath($x, $p) : $x;
        $w = $p !== '' ? getPath($y, $p) : $y;
        return lt_($u, $w) ? -$dir : (lt_($w, $u) ? $dir : 0);
    });
    return $l;
}

/** The first item, or null. */
function first(mixed $a): mixed
{
    return asArray($a)[0] ?? null;
}

/** The last item, or null. */
function last(mixed $a): mixed
{
    $l = asArray($a);
    return $l ? $l[\count($l) - 1] : null;
}

/** Groups items by the text of a path: { value: [items] }. */
function groupBy(mixed $a, mixed $path): \stdClass
{
    $p = str($path);
    $groups = new \stdClass();
    foreach (asArray($a) as $x) {
        $k = toStringValue($p !== '' ? getPath($x, $p) : $x);
        $list = \property_exists($groups, $k) ? $groups->{$k} : [];
        $list[] = $x;
        $groups->{$k} = $list;
    }
    $out = new \stdClass();
    foreach (keyList($groups) as $k) $out->{$k} = $groups->{$k};
    return $out;
}

/** The mean of numbers or of a path; 0 for an empty list. */
function average(mixed $a, mixed $path): float
{
    $n = \count(asArray($a));
    return $n === 0 ? 0.0 : sum($a, $path) / $n;
}

// ---------- validation: every check returns { valid, message } ----------

function valid_(): \stdClass
{
    return obj('valid', true, 'message', '');
}

function invalid_(string $message): \stdClass
{
    return obj('valid', false, 'message', $message);
}

function checkRequired(mixed $v, mixed $field): \stdClass
{
    return isEmpty($v) ? invalid_(str($field) . ' is required') : valid_();
}

function checkEmail(mixed $v, mixed $field): \stdClass
{
    return \is_string($v) && \preg_match('/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/u', $v) ? valid_() : invalid_(str($field) . ' must be a valid email');
}

function valueType_(mixed $v): string
{
    if ($v === null) return 'null';
    if (\is_array($v)) return 'array';
    if (\is_int($v)) return 'integer';
    if (\is_float($v)) return \is_finite($v) && \floor($v) === $v ? 'integer' : 'number';
    if (\is_string($v)) return 'string';
    if (\is_bool($v)) return 'boolean';
    return 'object';
}

function checkType(mixed $v, mixed $type, mixed $field): \stdClass
{
    $vt = valueType_($v);
    $t = str($type);
    return $vt === $t || ($t === 'number' && $vt === 'integer') ? valid_() : invalid_(str($field) . " must be $t");
}

/** The first problem of a value against a shape, or null. */
function checkValue_(mixed $v, mixed $s, string $path): ?string
{
    if (!$s instanceof \stdClass || eq(get($s, 'type'), 'any')) return null;
    $type = get($s, 'type');
    if ($v === null) return truthy(get($s, 'nullable')) || eq($type, 'null') ? null : "$path is null";
    $t = valueType_($v);
    if (eq($type, 'number') && ($t === 'integer' || $t === 'number')) return null;
    if (!eq($type, $t)) return "$path: expected " . str($type) . ", got $t";
    $en = get($s, 'enum');
    if (\is_array($en) && $en && !includes($en, $v)) return "$path: " . json($v) . ' is not one of ' . \implode(', ', \array_map(jsString(...), $en));
    $props = get($s, 'properties');
    if ($props instanceof \stdClass && $v instanceof \stdClass) {
        foreach (keyList($props) as $k) {
            if (!\property_exists($v, $k)) {
                if (truthy(get($props->{$k}, 'required'))) return "$path.$k is missing";
                continue;
            }
            $p = checkValue_($v->{$k}, $props->{$k}, "$path.$k");
            if ($p !== null) return $p;
        }
    }
    if (\is_array($v)) {
        foreach ($v as $i => $x) {
            $p = checkValue_($x, get($s, 'items'), "{$path}[$i]");
            if ($p !== null) return $p;
        }
    }
    return null;
}

function checkShape(mixed $v, mixed $shape, mixed $field): \stdClass
{
    $p = checkValue_($v, $shape, str($field));
    return $p !== null ? invalid_($p) : valid_();
}

function checkRange(mixed $v, mixed $lo, mixed $hi, mixed $field): \stdClass
{
    if (!\is_int($v) && !\is_float($v)) return invalid_(str($field) . ' must be a number');
    if ($lo !== null && !eq($lo, '') && $v < toNum($lo)) return invalid_(str($field) . ' must be ≥ ' . jsString($lo));
    if ($hi !== null && !eq($hi, '') && $v > toNum($hi)) return invalid_(str($field) . ' must be ≤ ' . jsString($hi));
    return valid_();
}

function checkRegex(mixed $v, mixed $pattern, mixed $field): \stdClass
{
    $re = '/' . \str_replace('/', '\/', str($pattern)) . '/u';
    $ok = @\preg_match($re, str($v));
    if ($ok === false) return invalid_('invalid pattern');
    return $ok ? valid_() : invalid_(str($field) . ' has an invalid format');
}

function checkPassword(mixed $v, mixed $policy, mixed $field): \stdClass
{
    $p = str($v);
    $min = toNum(get($policy, 'minLength'));
    if (\count(units($p)) < $min) return invalid_(str($field) . ' must be at least ' . numText($min) . ' characters');
    if (truthy(get($policy, 'requireDigit')) && !\preg_match('/[0-9]/', $p)) return invalid_(str($field) . ' must contain a digit');
    if (truthy(get($policy, 'requireUpper')) && !\preg_match('/[A-Z]/', $p)) return invalid_(str($field) . ' must contain an uppercase letter');
    return valid_();
}

// ---------- conversion ----------

/** Objects become JSON. */
function toStringValue(mixed $v): string
{
    return container_($v) ? json($v) : ($v === null ? '' : jsString($v));
}

/** Not a number is 0. */
function toNumber(mixed $v): float
{
    $n = jsNumber($v);
    return \is_nan($n) ? 0.0 : $n;
}

function isNumeric(mixed $v): bool
{
    return !\is_nan(jsNumber($v));
}

function toBoolean(mixed $v): bool
{
    return truthy($v);
}

/** string, integer, number, boolean, object, array or null. */
function typeOf(mixed $v): string
{
    return valueType_($v);
}

// ---------- math ----------

/** Math.min and Math.max: NaN wins, -0 is below 0. */
function jsMin_(float $a, float $b): float
{
    if (\is_nan($a) || \is_nan($b)) return \NAN;
    if ($a == $b) return \fdiv(1, $a) < 0 ? $a : $b;
    return $a < $b ? $a : $b;
}

function jsMax_(float $a, float $b): float
{
    if (\is_nan($a) || \is_nan($b)) return \NAN;
    if ($a == $b) return \fdiv(1, $a) < 0 ? $b : $a;
    return $a > $b ? $a : $b;
}

/** 0-15 decimals, halves up. */
function round(mixed $v, mixed $decimals): float
{
    $x = toNum($v);
    $d = trunc_(toNum($decimals));
    $f = 10 ** (\is_finite($d) ? \max(0, \min(15, (int) $d)) : 0);
    $y = $x * $f + 0.5;
    return \is_finite($y) ? \floor($y) / $f : $x;
}

function floor(mixed $v): float
{
    return \floor(toNum($v));
}

function ceil(mixed $v): float
{
    return \ceil(toNum($v));
}

function abs(mixed $v): float
{
    return \abs(toNum($v));
}

function min(mixed $a, mixed $b): float
{
    return jsMin_(toNum($a), toNum($b));
}

function max(mixed $a, mixed $b): float
{
    return jsMax_(toNum($a), toNum($b));
}

/** Keeps the value between lo and hi. */
function clamp(mixed $v, mixed $lo, mixed $hi): float
{
    return jsMin_(jsMax_(toNum($v), toNum($lo)), toNum($hi));
}

/** JavaScript's ** (1 ** Infinity is NaN). */
function power(mixed $a, mixed $b): float
{
    $x = toNum($a);
    $y = toNum($b);
    return \is_nan($y) || (\abs($x) == 1 && \is_infinite($y)) ? \NAN : \pow($x, $y);
}
